description: This file defines a timezone-aware Date object (`timezoneJS.Date`) with support for Olson timezone data, including methods for serialization, timezone calculations, and zone data management. It also includes timezone data parsing and zone file loading mechanisms.

classes.name: timezoneJS.Date
classes.description: A constructor function that mimics the native JavaScript Date object but adds full timezone support, serialization, and extended properties.

methods.name: getTzInfo
methods.description: Retrieves timezone offset and abbreviation for a given date and timezone.

methods.name: loadZoneFile
methods.description: Loads timezone zone data files via XHR, either synchronously or asynchronously.

methods.name: parseZones
methods.description: Parses zone data strings into internal zone and rule structures.
